invariants.rule: Product Line is reusable across Customers; customer-specific SLA authority exists only at Contract Product Line.
Each Contract belongs to exactly one Customer Organization.
An SR has at most one active CPL classification and it must be compatible with the SR's resolved Customer.
Advanced Search Product is discarded and cannot establish Product Line/CPL/SLA authority.
Missing Report Date produces an explicitly uncalculable SLA result.
Suspension duration is accepted source evidence only and is never inferred from inactivity.
Eligible terminal SLA endpoint is the first accepted effective Resolved/Closed instant; Cancelled SRs remain historical but leave SLA cohorts.
SLA elapsed arithmetic is exact and clamped at zero; no premature rounding affects tier/state decisions.
Canonical cohort month uses accepted Report Date in America/Guayaquil; Objective timezone has no membership authority.
Canonical cohort key is Customer + Contract + CPL + severity + policy tier within month; compliance outcome/state is not a key dimension.
Individual SLA state and cohort compliance state/percentage are distinct projections.
An open monthly cohort is never labeled final.
Policy/classification changes recompute live projections but never rewrite completed report evidence.
Completed report evidence is published only after artifact verification from one consistent accepted-state snapshot.
Report generation, live recalculation or terminal status never grants cleanup/deletion authority over operational records.
